mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate signals a robust economy, leading to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate below 4.5% triggers an increase in borrowing and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the federal funds rate is below 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate above 5% signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the unemployment rate is above 5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production signals an increase in economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong industrial production growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts signals a decrease in consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when housing starts are below 1400 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate above 5.5% and a decrease in GDP growth rate signal a monetary tightening cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the federal funds rate is above 5.5% and GDP growth rate is below 2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment and a decrease in the unemployment rate signal a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when payroll employment is above 138000 and the unemployment rate is below 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in retail sales and an increase in the consumer price index signal a decrease in consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when retail sales are below 370000 and the consumer price index is above 210 (t-test p > 0.05).
